description: Defines classes and methods for a custom memory pool allocator, including PoolAllocator and Allocation classes, with guard block sanity checking and memory management functionalities.

classes.name: Allocation
classes.description: Represents a memory allocation with optional guard blocks for sanity checking.

classes.name: PoolAllocator
classes.description: A custom memory pool allocator for efficient small memory requests, supporting push/pop stack semantics.

methods.name: AllocationSize
methods.description: Calculates total size needed for an allocation including guard blocks and header.

methods.name: OffsetAllocation
methods.description: Returns pointer offset to user data from the start of the allocation.

methods.name: checkAllocList
methods.description: Checks the list of allocations for consistency.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Establishes a new point in the pool to which allocations can be popped back.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Frees all allocations made since the last push.

methods.name: popAll
methods.description: Frees all allocations in the pool.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size.

methods.name: fastAllocate
methods.description: Provides a faster allocation path when alignment is 1.

methods.name: allocateNewPage
methods.description: Allocates a new page of memory when needed.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Prevents further allocations (thread safety or similar).
